WITH payload AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS d
)

INSERT INTO change_governance_decisions (
    change_request_id,
    assessment_id,
    decision,
    decision_comments,
    conditions,
    decided_by
)

SELECT
    (d->>'change_request_id')::bigint,
    NULLIF(d->>'assessment_id', '')::bigint,
    d->>'decision',
    NULLIF(d->>'decision_comments', ''),
    NULLIF(d->>'conditions', ''),
    d->>'decided_by'

FROM payload

RETURNING
    decision_id,
    change_request_id,
    assessment_id,
    decision,
    decision_comments,
    conditions,
    decided_by,
    decided_at;

UPDATE change_requests
SET
    change_status = CASE
        WHEN $1 = 'Approved' THEN 'Approved'
        WHEN $1 = 'Approved with Conditions' THEN 'Approved'
        WHEN $1 = 'Rejected' THEN 'Rejected'
        WHEN $1 = 'Request More Information' THEN 'Under Assessment'
        ELSE change_status
    END,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE change_request_id = $2
RETURNING
    change_request_id,
    change_request_code,
    change_status,
    updated_at;
